messages.subject: Lunch & Learn: 2026 trends in venture term sheets (15 April, 12.30)
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us for the next Corporate Lunch & Learn on Wednesday 15 April at 12.30 in Room 4.2 (and on Teams). Our guest speaker will cover recent trends in UK venture term sheets — liquidation preferences, option-pool sizing and the rise of the materiality scrape. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD.

RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
